Workflow.Name: Verify account address with Melissa Express Entry (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a account changes: checks it with Melissa Global Address Verification, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything Melissa Express Entry returned. Part of the Melissa Express Entry sample app.
